hits.title: Data retention policy v4
hits.snippet: Customer logs are retained for 18 months unless a longer period is required for an active investigation or legal hold.

hits.title: Master services agreement
hits.snippet: Limitation of liability is capped at twelve months of fees, excluding confidentiality and data-protection obligations.

hits.title: Vendor MSA — Northwind
hits.snippet: Northwind shall maintain insurance coverage and indemnify Poluru Labs for third-party claims arising from the licensed services.

hits.title: Incident response runbook
hits.snippet: Severity-1 incidents page Knowledge Ops and Security within 15 minutes. Evidence is stored in the Vault incident folder.

hits.title: Onboarding checklist — APAC
hits.snippet: APAC hires receive workspace access within one business day after People Ops confirms the start date.
